topic: roadmap.json must be merged, never chosen
lesson: plans/roadmap.json is shared state between concurrent sessions. Resolving a conflict in it with 'git checkout --ours/--theirs' silently DELETES the other session's stories - it looks clean and the item count can even stay the same, so nothing flags it. Union the items from both sides and re-run 'forge roadmap heal'. The other .factory bookkeeping files in the same conflict set (grill briefs, grills/*.json) are per-run and may be chosen; roadmap.json may not.
source: ask-reopen-saved-report branch rebuild: a blanket --theirs dropped the merged multi-plant story while leaving 10 items, so the count gave no warning
